metadata.name: Pickup Merge
metadata.description:
Pickup Merge
Too many pickups on the floor? Merge them.
Rooms full of coins, keys, bombs and hearts can tank your FPS. This mod merges them into their bigger versions, so the value stays and the entity count drops.
- Coins: 2 pennies = double penny, 5 = nickel, 10 = dime, 50 = lucky penny (2 double pennies + 1 penny = nickel, it all adds up) - Keys: 2 keys = double key - Bombs: 2 bombs = double bomb, 40 = giga bomb - Red hearts: 2 halves = full heart, 2 full = double heart - Soul hearts: 2 halves = soul heart, 2 soul hearts = black heart
Red and soul hearts never mix.
By default it merges when you leave a room and come back (never on your first visit). You can also merge with a key instead, or both.
Never touched: shop items, "choose one" pickups, and special pickups (sticky nickel, golden pennies/keys/bombs, lucky penny, charged key, troll bombs, eternal/bone/rotten/golden hearts...).
Mod Config Menu (optional): - Pickup Merge ON/OFF (turn it off and the other options hide) - Merge on: Re-enter room / Key press / Both (default Re-enter room) - Merge key: any keyboard key (default M) - Big merges ON/OFF: 50 coins -> Lucky penny, 40 bombs -> Giga bomb, 2 soul -> Black heart. These trade value for something special, turn them off if you'd rather keep the full value.
No REPENTOGON needed.
